content:
Alex L.: morning — quick handoff for today. I prewarmed 8 nodes in us-west2 (see infra-runbook note). bumped az quota for the pool and pushed terraform change `terraform/az/alloc.tf` (small count delta). I saw a short spike in the gpu queue ~03:12 that triggered autoscale, logs are in s3://redwood-logs/provision/21098765.log. tagging @Tara P. and @Mike R. for a quick verify, then i'll toggle the canary routing back on.
Tara P.: saw the prewarm job succeed but one node had an OOM shortly after init — `OOM killed process: python` in journal. Node id: usw2-prewarm-03. I'm isolating it, might repro with the current container image. holding traffic to that pod. @Alex L. did you change any resource limits in the new alloc.tf?
Alex L.: nope no resource limit changes, only count. alloc.tf diff: `-count = 2 -> +count = 10` and a small tag. suspect image sidecar memory usage; i'll revert the node group for now and redeploy a canary with the older image.
Mike R.: I validated quota bump in the console for us-west2 reserved pool. also pushed a tentative spot fallback plan for eu-west1 to add 10% headroom. command i used to spin test nodes: `./scripts/prewarm --region=eu-west1 --count=4 --type=gpu` — works locally. if we want to push spot fallback live i need an approval from infra-oncall.
infra-oncall: noted — approving manual spot fallback for non-prod only. will not apply to prod until we get a checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
Sasha G.: blocker: the support ticket for GPU quota increase in ap-southeast is still pending, PR #342 (https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/342) is waiting for cloud team signoff. this blocks scaling for some customer tests today.
Alex L.: thanks Sasha — i'll ping cloud-support and add the PR to today's sync. @infra-oncall can you escalate the ap-southeast quota ticket if we need to run customer tests later?
infra-oncall: escalated the ticket and added a note to the incident queue. if cloud doesn't respond in 2h we'll open a temporary region fallback for those customers.
Tara P.: repro steps for the OOM attached in the runbook note and in the bug thread. shortterm: i'll cordon the node and relaunch 2 prewarm nodes with reduced sidecar mem: `kubectl set resources deployment/sidecar -c sidecar --limits=memory=256Mi` ; will watch for impact.
Alex L.: sounds good — i'll revert the alloc count for now and mark the canary as paused. keeping this thread for quick updates; ping me for any urgent rollbacks. :thumbsup:
